scope: Same 16 validation documents; post-selection component audit with fixed already-fitted association models and threshold 0.3. Local approximate four metrics; no independent-test or statistical-significance claim.
kb_only_definition: Only mapped HPO units from the fixed HPO/UMLS candidate branch of knowledge_union; no learned NER spans or fold-trained aliases. Original already-fitted patient model reused without refitting.
umls_ablation_scope: HPO-only versus HPO+UMLS candidate inputs while holding the HPO+UMLS-trained association model fixed. Measures conditional candidate changes; not a full retrained UMLS ablation.
delta_matching_scope: Mention TP assignments reproduce the local scorer, including one match per unmapped gold span; document concepts use its -1 bucket convention. Added/removed sets are not additive attribution when gold-unmapped matching changes.

frozen_cpu_reference.scope: Existing frozen OOF predictions rescored only on exactly the same 16 documents with the current same local scorer; no CPU fitting or inference rerun. This historic OOF set was used for model selection and is not an independent test.

frozen_configuration_metadata.selection_rule: Highest pooled document-held-out score among four predeclared configurations.

interpretation_limits: All comparisons reuse a repeatedly inspected validation fold; no independence or significance claim.
The frozen CPU reference differs in candidate resources and patient association method; a score gap cannot isolate NER, UMLS, or the association learner.
NER contribution is measured conditionally by adding its selected predictions to the mapped fixed-KB branch using the same fitted association model.
HPO versus HPO+UMLS holds the existing full-KB-trained association model fixed; this is candidate-level ablation, not retraining.
Entity strategy, checkpoint and thresholds were already selected on these documents; post-hoc component scores are descriptive.

findings.interpretation: Knowledge-base candidates dominate retained entity units. NER adds both true and false positives. Relative to frozen CPU, cap100 has lower entity F1 metrics and higher association metrics; the net difference cannot isolate NER, UMLS or association learning.
